tool_args.rationale: The observations show sink dependence and a long-horizon sign reversal. This revision tests sink-coupling structures and a delayed slow response alongside ordinary exponential adaptation, fitting every parameter numerically. Fresh confirmation is needed to determine whether the selected training fit generalizes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Their fresh-confirmation RMSE exceeded the 0.045 tolerance.
